Everything in this release comes from [PR #1](https://github.com/Ragnatela666/mini-oled-dock/pull/1) by [Desox](https://github.com/Desox96). Thanks!

Nothing changes unless you turn it on: every new feature is an option, off by default (the language stays on *System*, as before). An old `config.json` keeps working.

### New

- **Win key opens Start** (`win_opens_start`, also in Settings). One tap of Win opens the dock and Start together with a single animation, the next tap closes both. Off by default: Win still shows / hides the dock and a double tap opens Start.
- **Language** (Settings → Appearance → Language, `language`): System, English or Italian. Applied at once, no restart. Clock, date and calendar follow the chosen language.
- **Horizontal Start** (Settings → Start menu → Horizontal, `start_style`). Windows 11 style: search, a 6×3 grid of pinned apps with pages, "All apps ›", user name and a power flyout inside Start. The vertical Start is still the default and unchanged. Both styles share the same pins.
  - **Import from Windows Start**: copies the pinned apps of the Windows Start menu, in the same order, via `Export-StartLayout`.
- **Spatial sound and volume mixer** in the volume popup: the spatial formats actually usable on the selected output (Windows Sonic, Dolby Atmos…), and a row with mute and slider for each app playing audio.
- **Customizable volume popup** (`audio_layout`): sections can be collapsed with ▾/▸; the pencil turns on *Customize*, where the eye hides a section and dragging a header reorders it. Hidden or collapsed sections load nothing.
- **Tray context menus** open centered above the icon, like the menus of the bar apps.

### Fixes

- **Tray panels opening at the top-left corner** (Logitech G HUB and other WinUI 3 apps): the hidden `Shell_TrayWnd` now has a taskbar-like rectangle.
- **Apps launched from the dock opening behind other windows**: the dock now passes its foreground rights to Explorer before launching.
- **Win key in fullscreen games**: when the game grabs the foreground back, the dock takes it again for Start (at most twice) instead of closing everything.

### Install / update

Requires Windows 11. Download `dock.exe` and run it from a terminal:

```powershell
.\dock.exe --install
```

It asks for administrator rights, copies itself to `%ProgramFiles%\mini-oled-dock` and starts with Windows. To update, run `--install` from the new `dock.exe`: the running dock is stopped and restarted from the new copy. Settings are kept.

### Known limitations

- Some tray apps may show their menu at the click point for an instant before it moves above the icon.
- DTS spatial sound has not been tested on a machine that has it installed.
- The power flyout in the horizontal Start works with the mouse only.
- The exe is not code-signed, so SmartScreen may warn on the first run.
